wikipediaRead.locator: Current article lines 167–180 and 194–195: explicitly about ancient town; identifies current tell as Lachish; distinguishes modern moshav; lines 188–190 gives site area/excavations.
wikipediaRead.supportJa: 記事は古代の町を対象とし、テル・ラキシュをその遺跡として同定する一方、近隣の現代集落を区別する。古代都市の範囲と遺跡は同一とは限らない。

primaryWitnesses.nextContext: Zorah, Aijalon, and Hebron, which are fortified cities in Judah and in Benjamin.

primaryWitnesses.text: Now from the time that Amaziah turned away from following the LORD, they made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem. He fled to Lachish, but they sent after him to Lachish and killed him there.
primaryWitnesses.previousContext: Now the rest of the acts of Amaziah, first and last, behold, aren’t they written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel?
primaryWitnesses.nextContext: They brought him on horses and buried him with his fathers in the City of Judah.

primaryWitnesses.text: After this, Sennacherib king of Assyria sent his servants to Jerusalem, (now he was attacking Lachish, and all his forces were with him), to Hezekiah king of Judah, and to all Judah who were at Jerusalem, saying,
primaryWitnesses.previousContext: An arm of flesh is with him, but the LORD our God is with us to help us and to fight our battles.” The people rested themselves on the words of Hezekiah king of Judah.
primaryWitnesses.nextContext: Sennacherib king of Assyria says, “In whom do you trust, that you remain under siege in Jerusalem?
